metric-degradation.description: A metric of a performance test changed significantly between builds. Change-point analysis splits the metric history into segments and reports when the median of the latest segment differs from the previous one by more than the threshold. A test that stops producing data is reported to the same target after `missingDataDays` days.

eventFields.branch: Branch the tests ran on, e.g. master
eventFields.db: ClickHouse database of the test results, e.g. perfintDev or perfint
eventFields.machine: Machine name pattern, `*` matches any sequence, e.g. intellij-linux-hw-hetzner*
eventFields.metric: Metric name as shown on the dashboards, e.g. showFileHistory; `*` matches any sequence. Omit the field to let IJ Perf pick the metrics from each test's name (see `spec.metricRules`).
eventFields.mode: Test mode, e.g. split or with-aia; `default` (the default when omitted) selects runs without a mode
eventFields.project: Test name as shown on the dashboards, e.g. intellij_sources/git-commit; startup runs are tests too, named `<project>/measureStartup`. `*` matches any sequence and is resolved against the tests that ran on the block's branches and machines in the last 30 days, so `kotlin/*` is every kotlin test and `*` every test of the table.
eventFields.table: Table in the database, e.g. idea, kotlin, ml

metric-threshold.description: The latest value of a metric crossed a fixed threshold, for example a quota reached 95 %. No change-point analysis, so it also fires on the very first build over the threshold.

eventFields.branch: Branch the tests ran on, e.g. master
eventFields.db: ClickHouse database of the test results, e.g. perfintDev or perfint
eventFields.machine: Machine name pattern, `*` matches any sequence, e.g. intellij-linux-*-aws-*
eventFields.metric: Metric name as shown on the dashboards, e.g. currentPercents
eventFields.mode: Test mode, e.g. split or with-aia; `default` (the default when omitted) selects runs without a mode
eventFields.project: Test name as shown on the dashboards, e.g. "prod: tokenQuota"
eventFields.table: Table in the database, e.g. idea, kotlin, ml

unit-test-degradation.description: A performance unit test (perfUnitTests) got slower or faster between builds. Every unit test is an event: a subscriber receives the tests whose code owner it claims in subscriber.yaml, plus the tests its match blocks select by name. IJ Perf resolves the owner from the CodeOwners metadata of the test and knows no group hierarchy, so a claim matches the group name exactly.

eventFields.test: Fully qualified test name, e.g. "com.intellij.java.codeInsight.PerfTest.testFoo - foo"; `*` matches any sequence, so "com.intellij.java.*" is every test of that package.
